results.title: Research Radio on Apple Podcasts
results.snippet: Fabio Giglietto is the creator and curator of 'Research Radio,' a podcast series that translates computational social science papers into AI-narrated deep-dive audio discussions. Recent episodes in August and September 2026 cover topics such as coordinated online behavior and trust in the news.

results.title: SMSociety 2026 Conference Programme - Meta Content Library Community Roundtable: Where to for Social Media Research?
results.snippet: Fabio Giglietto was featured as a prominent panelist at the #SMSociety 2026 International Conference on Social Media & Society in Glasgow (July 2026). He participated in a dedicated roundtable session discussing the current state of academic data access, transitioning from decommissioned tools like CrowdTangle to Meta's Content Library.
